text:
oliver: Hey — noticed a ~60% drop in reported spans for inference-worker-{0..3} since ~02:30 UTC. Traces look very sparse in Grafana. Anyone changed sampling or the collector recently?

mohit: oh yikes. was it gradual or a hard cutoff?

oliver: hard-ish. timeline: logs show normal starts but fewer spans emitted. app logs still contain traceparent headers. Grafana panel: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/trace-overview?panelId=7&orgId=1

elaine: do you see OTEL exporter errors in the worker logs? try `kubectl logs deploy/inference-worker -c main --since=3h | grep -i otel`

oliver: ran that, no obvious exporter errors. saw this repeated warning from the SDK: `Dropped span due to sampler decision` around the time it drops.

mohit: that message usually means SDK sampling rate changed or parent sampling is false. which SDK are we running in those pods?

oliver: Python opentelemetry 1.22 + opentelemetry-exporter-otlp 1.16. We set sampler via env var in the helm chart: OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased_traceidratio and OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.05 (5%).

elaine: hmm 5% should still emit some spans. Could the collector be doing tail sampling or an aggressive rate limit? collector config is in `infra/observability/collector/collector.yaml` (recent change last week).

ara: fyi I merged a collector tweak Thursday that added a tail-sampling rule for long-running traces to avoid storage blowups. not confident it would drop whole services though. link: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/observability/-/merge_requests/412

mohit: can you paste the sampling config from the collector? maybe there's an unintended match rule.

ara: sending snippet: ```yaml
processors:
  tail_sampling:
    policies:
      - name: drop-big-service
        matching_criteria:
          - attributes:
              - key: service.name
                value: /inference-worker.*/
        decision: drop
        rate_limit: 0.0
```

oliver: whoa that looks like it would drop all inference-worker traces. was that intended?

ara: oh no, that was supposed to be a conditional rule for high-error traces only. I messed up the criteria when rebasing.

devops-bot: [deploy-bot] deploy infra/observability/collector/collector.yaml to prod succeeded at 2026-03-15T02:28:05Z :white_check_mark:

elaine: ok, rollback or fix asap. either tighten the matching_criteria or set decision: retain and add more checks.

mohit: quick mitigation: increase SDK sampling in the workers to 0.5 (50%) via helm override so we still get usable spans while we fix collector. run: `helm upgrade inference -f values-prod.yaml --set env.OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.5`

oliver: I'll do that in canary zone us-west-2a then watch Grafana.

mohit: also check that the instrumentation isn't creating 2-level parent sampling mismatch. our recommended config for python is: ```bash
export OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased_traceidratio
export OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.1
```

elaine: for long-term: we should add a per-service dashboard for span volume and sampling ratio. ara, can you add a Grafana panel to the infra/observability dashboard? Prefer a small sparklines row + anomaly alert if span_count drops >40% vs baseline.

ara: on it. PR incoming. which dashboard uid? use infra-obsv-2025 (IIRC).

oliver: FYI the alert that fired was `span-volume-threshold` at 02:34. It flagged a 55% drop for inference-worker-prod. SRE bot posted it: 

SRE-bot: [alert] span-volume-threshold fired for inference-worker-prod — dropped 54% vs 24h baseline. See https://alerts.redwood.ai/alerts/9832

oliver: after increasing sampler to 50% in canary, span volume back to ~70% of baseline in 5m. so collector rule is main culprit.

mohit: great. please revert the collector change and add a unit test / linter rule so wildcard matching against `service.name` requires an allow-list.

ara: I'll revert and open a follow-up to restrict matching_criteria and add a test.

elaine: also add a note in runbook: where to check `otel` env vars, collector tail-sampling, and the Grafana panel. copy for runbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/traces_sampling.md

oliver: pinging @ara for the collector MR review once you have the fix. tiny follow-up: can someone add a quick stacktrace view link (Jaeger-style) for the panel? helps triage.

ara: yup will add Jaeger link and the PR in ~30m.

devops-bot: [ci] pipeline for infra/observability reverted collector MR completed :white_check_mark:

oliver: thanks all — will monitor and file a postmortem note if we see any regression. :thumbsup:

mohit: cheers. and @oliver if you still see sparse spans after revert/helm change, DM me the pod names and I'll grab pcap/logs.

oliver: will do. thanks!
